children: Morguard intends to renew its share repurchase program to buy back up to 5% of its shares over the course of a one-year period.
The Canadian real estate and property management company said on Thursday the Toronto Stock Exchange has approved its plans to buy back up to 533,913 common shares for cancellation.

Shares have been slightly lower, both year to date and over the last year, falling 0.5% since the start of the year and 2.4% over the last 52 weeks to close on Wednesday at 115.35 Canadian dollars ($82.47).
At Wednesday's closing price, the value of the block of shares intended for buyback would be worth about C$61.6 million.
Morguard can begin buying back the shares starting on Sept. 22.
